title: Old-Style Sickles
description: Changes swords to look like sickles. Pre-1.14 style.
body:
This resource pack makes swords look like sickles (pre-1.14 style). Best used with other programmer art-esque resource packs.

Doesn't change any text, so swords are still called swords.

![Sickle being held by Steve.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c4fe8f2ecd7bce473b8c14b4e4c65c1b7558a2e9.jpeg)
(The other textures are all from [Programmer Art Continuation Project](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pacp) and the base game Programmer Art!)
